title: Rangers Promote Minor League Players Cody Freeman and Marco Gonzales
summary: The Texas Rangers have promoted minor league infielder/outfielder Cody Freeman and left-handed pitcher Marco Gonzales. This move brings both players up from the minor league system. Specific details regarding the reasons for the promotion or their immediate roles were not provided in the coverage.
summary_points: The Texas Rangers have promoted Cody Freeman.
The Texas Rangers have promoted Marco Gonzales.
Marco Gonzales is a left-handed pitcher.
Both players were promoted from the minor leagues.
